title: A paradoxical route from hyperbolic geometry to proper proximality
summary: For every integer $n\ge 2$, we introduce a new combinatorial condition PP$(n)$ inspired by paradoxical decompositions of groups. As $n$ increases, the property PP$(n)$ weakens, and the resulting hierarchy interpolates between group-theoretic manifestations of negative curvature and proper proximality. More precisely, we prove that a countable group is properly proximal if and only if it satisfies PP$(n)$ for some $n$.
